question_stem: A car of mass $1500\text{kg}$ is towing a trailer of mass $m\text{kg}$ along a straight horizontal road. The car and the trailer are connected by a tow-bar which is horizontal, light and rigid. There is a resistance force of $F\text{ N}$ on the car and a resistance force of $200\text{ N}$ on the trailer. The driving force of the car's engine is $3200\text{ N}$, the acceleration of the car is $1.25\text{ m s}^{-2}$ and the tension in the tow-bar is $300\text{ N}$.

parts.question_text: Find the value of $m$ and the value of $F$.
